title: 重力式ローラーコンベヤ
description: 荷さばき場・小さな倉庫で箱の搬送経路を示すローラーコンベヤ。少し傾いた固定ベッドに29本の個別ローラー、軸端、側部チャンネル、四脚・高さ調整足・斜め補強、低い側の荷止めと端部連結金具を造形。箱や隣接モジュールは含まず、一台として配置します。ローラー回転・荷物の移動や耐荷重検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.166 × 0.829 × 0.714 m、28,916三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A gravity-roller conveyor for parcel routes in loading areas and small warehouses. A slightly inclined fixed bed carries 29 separate rollers and axle ends, side channels, four legs with adjustable-looking feet, diagonal bracing, low-end stop and joining tabs. Boxes and neighboring modules are absent; place it as one complete machine. Roller rotation, parcel movement and load-rating validation are not provided. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.166 × 0.829 × 0.714 m; 28,916 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
